representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
})
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, check.names = FALSE)
if (!all(c("SampleID", "Group") %in% colnames(layout))) {
  stop("sample_layout.csv must contain SampleID and Group columns")
}
layout$SampleID_norm <- gsub("-", "_", layout$SampleID, fixed = TRUE)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")
meta <- layout[keep, , drop = FALSE]
missing_samples <- setdiff(meta$SampleID_norm, colnames(counts))
if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing count columns:", paste(missing_samples, collapse = ",")))
}
meta <- meta[match(meta$SampleID_norm, colnames(counts)), , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$SampleID_norm), , drop = FALSE]
counts_sub <- counts[, meta$SampleID_norm, drop = FALSE]
count_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_sub)
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "numeric"
count_matrix <- round(count_matrix)
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"
coldata <- data.frame(Group = factor(meta$Group, levels = c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")), row.names = meta$SampleID_norm)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_matrix, colData = coldata, design = ~ Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group", "CBD_IC50", "DMSO"), alpha = 0.05)
df <- data.frame(gene_id = rownames(res), as.data.frame(res), check.names = FALSE)
write.table(df, file = "de_results.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
de <- df[!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$padj < 0.05 & abs(df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5, , drop = FALSE]
up <- de$gene_id[de$log2FoldChange > 0]
down <- de$gene_id[de$log2FoldChange < 0]
universe <- df$gene_id[!is.na(df$pvalue)]
writeLines(up, con = "up_genes.txt")
writeLines(down, con = "down_genes.txt")
writeLines(universe, con = "universe_genes.tsv")
summary <- data.frame(metric = c("contrast", "n_samples", "n_universe", "n_de", "n_up", "n_down"), value = c("CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO", nrow(coldata), length(universe), nrow(de), length(up), length(down)))
write.table(summary, file = "de_summary.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript run_deseq2.R "$(inputs.counts.path)" "$(inputs.layout.path)"

set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
})
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, check.names = FALSE)
if (!all(c("SampleID", "Group") %in% colnames(layout))) {
  stop("sample_layout.csv must contain SampleID and Group columns")
}
layout$SampleID_norm <- gsub("-", "_", layout$SampleID, fixed = TRUE)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")
meta <- layout[keep, , drop = FALSE]
missing_samples <- setdiff(meta$SampleID_norm, colnames(counts))
if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing count columns:", paste(missing_samples, collapse = ",")))
}
sample_order <- colnames(counts)[colnames(counts) %in% meta$SampleID_norm]
meta <- meta[match(sample_order, meta$SampleID_norm), , drop = FALSE]
counts_sub <- counts[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]
count_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_sub)
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "numeric"
count_matrix <- round(count_matrix)
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"
coldata <- data.frame(Group = factor(meta$Group, levels = c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")), row.names = sample_order)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_matrix, colData = coldata, design = ~ Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group", "CBD_IC50", "DMSO"), alpha = 0.05)
df <- data.frame(gene_id = rownames(res), as.data.frame(res), check.names = FALSE)
write.table(df, file = "de_results.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
de <- df[!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$padj < 0.05 & abs(df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5, , drop = FALSE]
up <- de$gene_id[de$log2FoldChange > 0]
down <- de$gene_id[de$log2FoldChange < 0]
universe <- df$gene_id[!is.na(df$pvalue)]
writeLines(up, con = "up_genes.txt")
writeLines(down, con = "down_genes.txt")
writeLines(universe, con = "universe_genes.tsv")
summary <- data.frame(metric = c("contrast", "n_samples", "sample_order", "n_universe", "n_de", "n_up", "n_down"), value = c("CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO", nrow(coldata), paste(sample_order, collapse = ","), length(universe), nrow(de), length(up), length(down)))
write.table(summary, file = "de_summary.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
